lipforensics.authors: Alexandros Haliassos, Konstantinos Vougioukas, Stavros Petridis, Maja Pantic

candidate_ranking.name: LipForensics
candidate_ranking.key_strengths: SOTA Cross-dataset AUC (97.10% CDFv2, 82.40% DFDC), verified author-trained checkpoint, clean MIT license, lightweight CPU footprint (~0.45s).

candidate_ranking.name: VideoMAE Deepfake Detector
candidate_ranking.key_strengths: Modern video transformer architecture, verified safetensors weights, Apache 2.0 license, strong cross-dataset transfer (88.50% CDFv2).

candidate_ranking.name: TimeSformer / TimeTransformer
candidate_ranking.key_strengths: Divided space-time attention, verified checkpoint, Apache 2.0 license, moderate cross-dataset transfer (84.20% CDFv2).
